from collections import Counter, deque
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; big=set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; n=0
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); n+=1
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                            seen[ny][nx]=True; q.append((ny,nx))
                if n>=3: big.add(c)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] in big: continue
            nb=[g[i+dy][j+dx] for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if 0<=i+dy<h and 0<=j+dx<w]
            if not nb: continue
            cnt=Counter(nb); top=max(cnt.values())
            tied=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if v==top]
            if len(tied)==1: pick=tied[0]
            else:
                up,down,left,right=[g[i+dy][j+dx] if 0<=i+dy<h and 0<=j+dx<w else None
                                    for dy,dx in((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1))]
                cand=[c for c in tied if c!=bg and (
                    (up==c and right==c) or (up==c and left==c) or
                    (down==c and right==c) or (down==c and left==c))]
                pick=cand[0] if cand else bg
            out[i][j]=pick
    return out
for k in (1,2,3):
    print(k, transform(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])
